corrections.title: Add provisional 5v5 JMK and Leia counters versus Pirate King Hondo (#125, #126)
corrections.rationale: Owner approved JMK B / 58 / undersize 0 and LEIA A / 62 / undersize 0 as provisional planning estimates on the established scoring ladder, with exact attacking fives in supported matchup notes. Both decisions authorise one combined PR. Append Leia then JMK after all existing Hondo counters, preserving their complete rows and order; no global counter requirements or runtime policy changes.

Explicit provisional LEIA A / 62 / undersize 0 decision; exact five; single observed full win; combined implementation authorised.

provenance.conditions: 5v5 only versus Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka. Full attacking fives as documented in each matchup note. Exact defending lineup, relics, mods, omicrons and datacrons not recorded.

Existing global core-based roster filtering does not enforce all matchup-note members.
